objectifs.texte: The intern will build a data-driven model of the mixing process, define optimal dosing sequences and implement a simple batch record system.

donnees.texte: about 1 batch in 8 is out of specification
Raw material consumption is also 6% above the theoretical recipe

contraintes.texte: The intern must comply with chemical safety rules and wear PPE in the production area
Formulas must never be copied or taken off site

consignes.texte: Work in teams of 4 to 5 students.
Support every proposal with data from the case.
Comply with every listed constraint.

validation.commentaire: The two 10 m³ tanks and the automatic bottling line are omitted, although the two main performance indicators are included.

titre.texte: Industrial case – materiaux: analysis and improvement

contexte.texte: 1. Background. [ENTREPRISE_A] produces flint glass bottles and jars for the beverage and food industries using an end-fired regenerative furnace (150 t/day).

objectifs.texte: 3. Scope. Design an energy monitoring system with IoT sensors on the furnace, forehearths and annealing lehr, and develop an energy performance indicator dashboard aligned with ISO 50001.

donnees.texte: Natural gas consumption per tonne of glass has increased by 9% in 18 months
Energy now represents 38% of production cost

contraintes.texte: aligned with ISO 50001
Sensors must withstand 70 °C ambient temperature
Installation must be done without stopping the furnace
Total hardware cost must stay below TND 35,000

consignes.texte: Work in teams of 4 to 5 students.
Support every proposal with data from the case.
Comply with every listed constraint.

validation.commentaire: The fiche correctly captures the main objective and key energy indicators, along with the main technical and budget constraints. However, it omits the absence of process-level sub-metering and the available input data (anonymised gas bills, furnace PLC data and production reports), which are important for designing the monitoring system. The ISO 50001 reference is relevant, although it is listed under Constraints rather than Objectives. Citations and anonymisation appear correct in the displayed text. The project is feasible for engineering students, provided the required data and equipment are accessible.

titre.texte: Industrial case – logistique: analysis and improvement

contexte.texte: INDUSTRY PROBLEM SUBMISSION FORM – University–Industry Programme

objectifs.texte: Expected outcome: a vehicle routing model with time windows, and an alert system based on the truck temperature loggers.

donnees.texte: temperature excursions above 8 °C were recorded on 6% of deliveries

contraintes.texte: drivers' working time cannot exceed 9 hours per day
solution must run on our existing telematics platform
no personal data of drivers may be exported

consignes.texte: Work in teams of 4 to 5 students.
Support every proposal with data from the case.
Comply with every listed constraint.

validation.commentaire: The fiche correctly captures the expected routing model, time windows, temperature alert system, key performance indicators, and operational constraints. However, it omits the fleet size of 38 refrigerated trucks and the fact that route planning is currently performed manually every evening. These details are relevant to understanding the initial situation and defining the solution. Citations and anonymisation appear correct in the displayed text. The project is feasible for engineering students, provided access to the necessary routing and temperature data is available.

contexte.texte: 1. Contexte. [ENTREPRISE_A] assemble des cartes électroniques pour l'éclairage public et des compteurs communicants. L'atelier compte 3 lignes CMS (sérigraphie, pose de composants, four de refusion) et un poste de test ICT.

objectifs.texte: 3. Besoin. Concevoir une application de saisie sur tablette au poste, reliée à l'ERP Odoo, pour enregistrer les numéros de série, les contrôles AOI et les non-conformités.

donnees.texte: 2 à 3 erreurs de traçabilité par semaine
délai moyen de 26 h entre la fin d'un OF et sa clôture dans l'ERP

contraintes.texte: L'application doit fonctionner hors connexion pendant au moins 2 heures
Les données ne doivent pas quitter le réseau interne de l'usine

consignes.texte: Travailler en équipe de 4 à 5 étudiants.
Justifier chaque proposition par une donnée du cas.
Respecter toutes les contraintes listées.

validation.commentaire: La fiche reprend correctement l’objectif principal, les indicateurs du problème et les trois contraintes fonctionnelles. Cependant, elle omet des informations utiles du contexte industriel, notamment les trois lignes CMS et le poste de test ICT, ainsi que les données mises à disposition pour le projet : l’export anonymisé des OF 2025, le plan de l’atelier et la liste des postes. Leur ajout permettrait de mieux caractériser l’environnement et les ressources disponibles. Aucune invention manifeste n’est détectée ; les citations et l’anonymisation semblent correctes. Le projet paraît réalisable en 4 à 8 semaines, sous réserve de l’accès aux données et à l’environnement Odoo.
